[Benzinga news, 2026-10-21T22:01:48Z, by staff] CACI International Inc Reports Fiscal First Quarter 2027 Results and Raises Guidance
CACI International Inc announced its fiscal first quarter 2027 financial results, reporting $2.5 billion in revenue and raising its full-year outlook for revenue, adjusted net income, and adjusted EPS.
CACI International Inc reported revenue of $2.5 billion for the fiscal first quarter ended September 30, 2026, representing an 8.2% increase year-over-year. The company achieved net income of $130.4 million and adjusted net income of $171.0 million, with adjusted diluted EPS rising 11.8% to $7.66. CACI also reported strong operational performance, including $4.8 billion in contract awards and a 2.0x book-to-bill ratio. Driven by these results and a healthy pipeline, management raised its fiscal year 2027 guidance for revenue, adjusted net income, and adjusted EPS. CEO John Mengucci attributed the performance to the company's mission proximity, software-defined approach, and ability to invest ahead of customer needs.

memos_so_far.headline: Raise only to consensus: adj EPS guide midpoint $33.63 vs $33.64 estimate

Quoted summary: revenue '$2.5 billion ... an 8.2% increase'; 'adjusted diluted EPS rising 11.8% to $7.66'; '$4.8 billion in contract awards and a 2.0x book-to-bill ratio'.

What changed: the guidance moved up to where analysts already were; the adj EPS midpoint ($33.63) equals consensus ($33.64), sales midpoint $10.80B vs $10.808B. Strong awards, but nothing the estimates did not already carry.
Price: no IEX after-hours trades; CACI rose 2.1% in the session.
objections: The raise lands on consensus; no surprise to price.
